current_static_findings.evidence: 请求没有稳定request_id或idempotency_key，每次RPC retry只复用旧PcapIndexMeta字段
current_static_findings.consequence: Kafka已ACK但响应丢失时Agent重试会再次发布同一对象metadata

current_static_findings.evidence: 响应只有bool success和自由文本message，没有ack_scope receipt_id request hash或final_indexed
current_static_findings.consequence: Agent无法验证成功作用域、恢复同一receipt或区分Kafka ACK与最终索引

current_static_findings.evidence: Handler认证绑定后直接调用Kafka producer，仓内没有PCAP request ledger或transactional outbox
current_static_findings.consequence: 无法在响应丢失时判断同一请求已发布，也无法原子保存intent与未来receipt

current_static_findings.evidence: Kafka message key仅tenant:probe，不包含file key object receipt或manifest hash
current_static_findings.consequence: 同一对象metadata没有稳定逻辑identity，不同对象又被挤入同一宽分区key

current_static_findings.evidence: ProducerConfig.IdempotentKey为空时选择RoundRobin，即使每条Message带Key也不按key稳定分区
current_static_findings.consequence: 同一idempotency key的重试可落到不同分区，破坏单key顺序和下游按分区去重假设

current_static_findings.evidence: 代码注释声称acks all和retry自动提供幂等，但没有producer ID sequence或transactional ID配置
current_static_findings.consequence: 重试重复发布风险被错误文案掩盖，不能据此签发exactly-once receipt

current_static_findings.evidence: topic按broker count设置replication factor但没有冻结min.insync.replicas
current_static_findings.consequence: RequireAll静态代码只能证明当前ISR ACK，不能证明批准的最小副本耐久阈值

current_static_findings.evidence: validatePcapIndex只对zstd_level超范围写warn，不拒绝缺hash size time或object receipt字段
current_static_findings.consequence: partial或冲突manifest仍可通过Kafka ACK屏障并获得success响应

current_static_findings.evidence: WriteMessages成功只返回nil且抽象不保留partition offset或broker response receipt
current_static_findings.consequence: Gateway只能自报Kafka成功，无法把broker坐标绑定到durable PCAP receipt
